title: Wardmoor's hold-grief needed a second, distant step: the unsealed 'true founding record' had to be carried to and read at the oath-stone (several rooms away) to actually rest the hold and increment 'Hollows rested'; persuading the record-keeper to unseal it and reading it on the spot completed a different quest ('What the Roster Doesn't Say') but did not move the counter, with the extra requirement discoverable only via the item's own tooltip text.
